name: Block Editor Animations for WordPress – Gutenberg Animation Plugin with Scroll Effects
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Add professional scroll animations to your WordPress blocks with Block Editor Animations – the simple animation plugin for Gutenberg that makes your content come alive.

Stop settling for static WordPress pages. Block Editor Animations brings your Gutenberg blocks to life with scroll-triggered animations, fade effects, slide animations, and zoom effects. No coding required – just select any block, choose an animation effect, and watch your content animate beautifully as visitors scroll through your WordPress site.

Whether you’re building landing pages, showcasing portfolios, or creating engaging blog posts, Block Editor Animations helps you create eye-catching WordPress animations that capture attention without slowing down your site.

Why Choose Block Editor Animations?

  • Gutenberg Animation – Native WordPress Block Editor animation support
  • Scroll Animations – Animate blocks as visitors scroll your WordPress page
  • 20+ Animation Effects – Fade, slide, zoom, bounce, rotate, and more
  • Animation Presets – 5 professionally configured one-click animations
  • Live Preview – See WordPress animations in Block Editor before publishing
  • No Coding – Add scroll effects to WordPress blocks with simple clicks

How WordPress Block Animation Works

  1. Install and activate Block Editor Animations on your WordPress site
  2. Edit any page or post in the Gutenberg Block Editor
  3. Select the block you want to animate (heading, image, button, etc.)
  4. Open the Animation panel in block settings
  5. Choose an animation effect and customize timing
  6. Preview the scroll animation in the Block Editor

No technical knowledge required – works immediately with WordPress Gutenberg blocks.

Perfect For

  • Landing Pages with scroll-triggered animations for better engagement
  • Portfolio Websites showcasing work with smooth fade and slide effects
  • Business Sites adding professional WordPress animations to key sections
  • Blogs making content more engaging with animated blocks
  • Marketing Pages highlighting CTAs with attention-grabbing animations
  • Creative Agencies building animated WordPress sites for clients

WordPress Animation Features

Gutenberg Block Animation
Animate any WordPress Gutenberg block including headings, paragraphs, images, buttons, groups, columns, and more. Each block gets an Animation panel in the Block Editor settings with full control over animation effects, timing, delay, and trigger points.

Scroll Animation Effects
Trigger WordPress animations as visitors scroll your page. Choose when animations appear based on scroll position. Blocks fade in, slide up, zoom in, or bounce as they enter the viewport – creating engaging scroll-triggered WordPress animations.

Animation Effects Library
Access 20 professional animation effects across multiple categories: Fade (fade-in, fade-up, fade-down), Slide (slide-up, slide-down, slide-left, slide-right), Zoom (zoom-in, zoom-out), Rotate (rotate-left, rotate-right), Bounce, and more. Each animation effect is optimized for WordPress performance.

Animation Presets for WordPress
Use 5 professionally configured animation presets for instant one-click WordPress animations: Subtle Fade In, Attention Bounce, Smooth Slide Up, Dynamic Zoom In, and Elegant Rotate. Each preset combines animation effects with optimized timing, delay, and easing for professional results.

WordPress Block Editor Preview
Preview scroll animations directly in the Gutenberg Block Editor before publishing. See exactly how WordPress animations will appear to visitors without leaving the editor. Test different animation effects and timing until you achieve the perfect WordPress scroll animation.

Animation Customization
Control animation timing (duration from 0-3 seconds), animation delay (0-3 seconds), scroll offset (when animation triggers), and easing functions. Fine-tune WordPress animations for each block individually.

Usage

Once the WordPress animation plugin is installed and activated:

  1. Edit any page or post in the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg)
  2. Select the block you want to animate
  3. Look for the Animation panel in block settings sidebar
  4. Choose an animation effect from the dropdown
  5. Customize timing, delay, and offset as needed
  6. Preview the WordPress animation in the Block Editor

Here are the steps to use Block Editor Animations:

  1. Select Block – Click any Gutenberg block (heading, image, button, etc.)
  2. Open Animation Panel – Find Animation settings in the block sidebar
  3. Choose Effect – Select from 20 animation effects (fade, slide, zoom, etc.)
  4. Choose Preset – Or pick a quick preset for instant WordPress animation
  5. Customize Timing – Adjust duration, delay, and scroll offset
  6. Preview Animation – Use Block Editor preview to see scroll animations
  7. Publish – Your WordPress animations are now live!

Note: Advanced animation features (100+ effects, custom presets, video/gallery animations) require the Pro version.

WordPress Animation Settings

Animation Effect Options:
1. Open the Animation panel in any Gutenberg block
2. Select animation type: Fade, Slide, Zoom, Rotate, Bounce, Flip
3. Choose specific effect: fade-up, slide-left, zoom-in, etc.
4. Set animation duration (how long animation takes)
5. Set animation delay (when animation starts)
6. Set scroll offset (when animation triggers while scrolling)

Using Animation Presets in WordPress:
1. Open the Animation panel
2. Click the Quick Presets dropdown
3. Select: Subtle Fade In, Attention Bounce, Smooth Slide Up, Dynamic Zoom In, or Elegant Rotate
4. Preset automatically applies effect + optimized timing
5. Preview the WordPress scroll animation

Supported WordPress Blocks:
– Heading blocks
– Paragraph blocks
– Image blocks
– Button blocks
– Group blocks
– Column blocks
– Cover blocks
– Quote blocks

Features & Limitations

The Block Editor Animations WordPress animation plugin allows you to:

  • Add scroll animations to WordPress Gutenberg blocks
  • Animate blocks on scroll with 20+ professional animation effects
  • Use 5 professionally configured WordPress animation presets
  • Preview animations in WordPress Block Editor before publishing
  • Customize animation timing, delay, duration, and scroll offset
  • Animate headings, images, buttons, groups, columns in WordPress
  • Create fade animations, slide animations, zoom effects, rotate effects
  • Add scroll-triggered animations to WordPress landing pages
  • Animate WordPress blog posts and pages without coding
  • Reset all block animations with one click

WordPress Animation Components

20 pre-defined animation effects optimized for WordPress: fade-in, fade-up, fade-down, fade-left, fade-right, slide-up, slide-down, slide-left, slide-right, zoom-in, zoom-out, zoom-in-up, zoom-in-down, flip-up, flip-down, flip-left, flip-right, rotate-left, rotate-right, bounce.

Animation Presets
5 ready-to-use WordPress animation presets combining effects with optimized settings. Presets save time by applying professional animations with one click instead of configuring 7+ settings manually.

Block Animation Panel
Native WordPress Block Editor integration. Animation settings appear directly in Gutenberg block settings sidebar. Configure WordPress animations without leaving the Block Editor.

Scroll Animation Triggers
Animations trigger as visitors scroll WordPress pages. Set scroll offset to control when blocks animate. Create engaging scroll-triggered WordPress animations that appear at the perfect moment.

  • Video/Gallery Animation – Not supported (Pro animates video and gallery blocks)
  • Custom Animation Editor – Not included (Pro includes visual animation builder)
  • Global Settings – Limited (Pro includes site-wide animation controls)
  • Advanced Options – No mirror/once options (Pro includes advanced animation controls)
  • Priority Support – Community support only (Pro includes priority email support)

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, WordPress animation examples, and best practices on the Block Editor Animations Documentation page.

Block Editor Animations Pro

If you’re using the free WordPress animation plugin from WordPress.org and want Pro features, you can purchase the premium version on the Block Editor Animations Pro website.

Here are some features included in the Pro version:

  • 100+ Animation Effects – Massive WordPress animation library with advanced effects
  • Unlimited Custom Presets – Create, save, and manage your own WordPress animation presets
  • Custom Animation Editor – Visual animation builder for WordPress blocks
  • All WordPress Blocks – Animate any Gutenberg block including video and galleries
  • User Defined Blocks – Add animations to custom blocks and third-party blocks
  • Global Animation Settings – Control WordPress animations site-wide
  • Video Block Animation – Animate WordPress video blocks with scroll effects
  • Gallery Block Animation – Add scroll animations to WordPress gallery blocks
  • Advanced Options – Mirror animations, once-only triggers, overflow control
  • Animation Import/Export – Share WordPress animation presets across sites
  • Animation Search – Quickly find animation effects with Select2 search
  • Performance Optimization – Advanced CSS loading options for faster WordPress sites
  • Priority Support – Direct email support from WordPress animation experts
  • Regular Updates – Early access to new WordPress animation features
sections.installation:
Installing the WordPress animation plugin is straightforward. Contact support if you encounter any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher (Gutenberg Block Editor)
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Modern browser with CSS3 animation support

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Block Editor Animations
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Edit any page in Gutenberg Block Editor
  5. Select a block and open the Animation panel

Manual Installation

  1. Download the WordPress animation plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the block-editor-animations folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate Block Editor Animations
  5. Edit any page in Gutenberg to access animation features

After Activation

  1. Edit any page or post in WordPress Block Editor
  2. Select any block (heading, image, button, etc.)
  3. Look for the Animation panel in the block settings sidebar
  4. Choose an animation effect from the dropdown
  5. Use Quick Presets for instant professional WordPress animations
  6. Customize timing, delay, and scroll offset
  7. Preview animations using Block Editor preview mode
  8. Publish your animated WordPress page!

Quick Start:
1. Edit a page in Gutenberg
2. Select a heading block
3. Open Animation panel
4. Choose “Fade Up” effect
5. Preview and publish
6. Your WordPress heading now animates on scroll!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within a few business days.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

How do I add animations to WordPress blocks?

Edit any page in the WordPress Block Editor, select the block you want to animate, open the Animation panel in the sidebar, choose an animation effect (fade, slide, zoom, etc.), and publish. Your WordPress block now animates when visitors scroll the page.

What’s the best WordPress animation plugin for Gutenberg?

Block Editor Animations provides simple, lightweight scroll animations for WordPress Gutenberg blocks. Native Block Editor integration, 20+ animation effects, live preview, and one-click presets make it ideal for adding WordPress animations without complexity.

How to animate Gutenberg blocks on scroll?

Install Block Editor Animations, select any Gutenberg block, open the Animation panel, choose an effect like “fade-up” or “slide-left”, and adjust the scroll offset to control when the animation triggers. The WordPress block animates automatically as visitors scroll.

Does this work with all WordPress blocks?

The free version supports 8 core WordPress blocks: headings, paragraphs, images, buttons, groups, columns, covers, and quotes. Block Editor Animations Pro animates all WordPress blocks including video, galleries, and custom blocks.

How to create fade animations in WordPress?

Select any block in Gutenberg, open the Animation panel, choose a fade effect (fade-in, fade-up, fade-down, fade-left, fade-right), customize the duration and delay, and preview. Your WordPress block fades in beautifully as visitors scroll.

Can I animate WordPress images?

Yes, Block Editor Animations supports WordPress image blocks. Select any image in Gutenberg, choose an animation effect (zoom-in, fade-up, slide-left, etc.), and the image animates on scroll. Perfect for portfolio sites and galleries.

How to add slide animations to WordPress?

Select a Gutenberg block, open the Animation panel, choose a slide effect (slide-up, slide-down, slide-left, slide-right), adjust timing, and preview. Your WordPress content slides into view smoothly as visitors scroll down the page.

Does this slow down WordPress sites?

No, Block Editor Animations is optimized for WordPress performance. Animations use CSS3 and are hardware-accelerated. The plugin loads minimal JavaScript and only applies animations to blocks you’ve configured, ensuring fast WordPress page loads.

Can I preview WordPress animations before publishing?

Yes, the WordPress Block Editor includes live preview mode. Select any animated block and preview exactly how scroll animations will appear to visitors. Test different animation effects and timing before publishing your WordPress page.

How to use animation presets in WordPress?

Open the Animation panel on any Gutenberg block, click the Quick Presets dropdown, and select a preset: Subtle Fade In, Attention Bounce, Smooth Slide Up, Dynamic Zoom In, or Elegant Rotate. The preset applies instantly with optimized WordPress animation settings.

What animation effects are available?

The free WordPress animation plugin includes 20 effects: fade (in, up, down, left, right), slide (up, down, left, right), zoom (in, out, in-up, in-down), flip (up, down, left, right), rotate (left, right), and bounce. Pro version includes 100+ effects.

Can I animate WordPress buttons?

Yes, button blocks fully support animations. Add attention-grabbing effects like bounce, zoom-in, or slide-up to WordPress call-to-action buttons. Increase conversions with animated buttons that catch visitors’ attention as they scroll.

How to animate WordPress headings?

Select any heading block in Gutenberg, open the Animation panel, choose an effect like fade-up or slide-right, set the timing, and preview. Your WordPress headings animate smoothly as visitors scroll, creating engaging content hierarchies.

Does this work with WordPress page builders?

Block Editor Animations is designed for native WordPress Gutenberg blocks. It works perfectly with the Block Editor but may not support third-party page builders. Use it with Gutenberg for best results.

Can I animate WordPress landing pages?

Yes, Block Editor Animations is perfect for WordPress landing pages. Add scroll-triggered animations to hero sections, feature blocks, testimonials, pricing tables, and CTAs. Create engaging landing pages that convert better with WordPress animations.

How to remove WordPress block animations?

Select the animated block, open the Animation panel, and set the animation effect to “None” or click the Reset button. To remove all WordPress animations at once, use the Reset All Blocks option in plugin settings.
